decisions.decision: Speech = say -v Kanya per seat (12 lines, rates 170-230), wav 48k mono passed base64 into the page, AudioBufferSourceNode looped while on; pilot sine 4000+150*seat Hz, gain 0.007 (about -30 dB)
decisions.why: Loop keeps speech inside every window whatever the line length (longest 2.87 s); rejected one-shot retrigger (speech could end before the window).

decisions.decision: Seat identity = peak inside the pilot band (3800-5850 Hz) only; heard = pilot >= -75 dB at the seat bin (+-1) and speech rms >= 0.02; quiet = pilot < -85 dB and rms < 0.01
decisions.why: Measured pilot after Opus -57..-69 dB, silent streams about -140 dB; thresholds sit between with margin. Rejected -62/-80: P01 with 11 mixed streams dipped to -69 and failed.

decisions.decision: SLOT_MS 2600, SETTLE_MS 800, new GAP_MS 400 silent gap before each slot, ALL_MS 3500; clip now 65.5 s
decisions.why: First run showed the previous talker's jitter-buffer tail (rms 0.016, pilot -73 dB) leaking into the next window; a gap fixes it without loosening the quiet rule.

decisions.decision: No say / not darwin: WARN and sine 220+40*seat Hz stands in for the speech; same pilot checks
decisions.why: Per user decision; one code path, never a failure.

decisions.decision: Fixed B-1 (AC-5 needs >= MIN_SAMPLES and mixRms < T_OFF), S-2 (contract AC-5 wording to D-3), S-3 (README notes)
